src: vertical color-major blocks s, including their internal marker pixels
dst: left-to-right output block slots d with the same widths as the ordered source blocks
match_cond: rank(s) == rank(d) after applying the block-order rule
transform: copy each whole source block unchanged into its assigned output slot
multi_step: default order is a one-block left shift; if adjacent shared-color marker rows read the current block colors right-to-left, use reverse order
